comment: Foundational i18n configuration for quantumaikido.com. Addresses issues #75-#84. Locales are listed with their native (endonym) names rather than flags, because flags represent nations and can be politically sensitive (issue #76). Color semantics are cultural (issue #77): the per-locale overrides let meaning be tuned without forking the palette. Data meaning must never be conveyed by color alone.

colorSemantics._doc: Semantic color tokens per locale/theme. Color meaning is cultural (e.g. red = luck/celebration in China, danger in much of the West). These overrides are consumed by CSS via [data-locale] attribute scoping. The base palette in styles.css is already colorblind-safe and never conveys meaning by color alone (issue #77).

zh._doc: In Chinese culture red is auspicious/celebratory, not primarily 'danger'. Remap danger to a neutral high-contrast tone and reserve red for festive/positive accents.

ja._doc: Red (aka) carries protective/sacred connotations (torii, shrine). Treat red as accent rather than alarm.

sacredOrPoliticalSymbolsToAvoid: disputed-border map labels without neutral alternatives
_textExpansionNote: Translations can be 30-40% longer than English; layouts should leave room for expansion (issue #76). Use this factor when sizing fixed-width containers.
